target: bcom ldan 'das phyag bcu gnyis pa dang / phyag drug pa dang / phyag bzhi pa dang / hA la hA la dang / don yod zhags pa dang / rta mgrin dkar po dang / mgrin pa mtha' yas dang / mgrin sngon dang / mgrin bzang dang / / mgul bzang dang / mgul dkar dang / mgul sngon dang / 'jig rten mgul pa dang / rnam par lta ba dang / lta ba dang / kun tu lta ba dang / dbang phyug dang / 'od zer stong ldan dang / yid dang / yid las byung ba dang / rnam par grags pa'i yid dang / pad+ma dang / phyag na pad+ma dang / yid la bsam pa dang / dbugs 'byin dang / rab tu rgod pa dang / skra bzang dang / skra mthar byed dang / rgyu skar dang / rgyu skar gyi rgyal po dang / zhi ba dang / bskal pa bzang po dang / 'dul byed mchog ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa phyag bcu gnyis dang / phyag drug pa dang / phyag bzhi ba dang / hA la hA la dang / don yod zhags pa dang / rta mgrin dang / mgrin pa mtha' yas dang / mgrin pa sngon po dang / mgrin pa bzang po dang / mgul bzang dang / mgrin dkar dang / mgrin sngon dang / 'jig rten mgrin pa dang / rnam par gzigs pa'i dbang phyug dang / 'od zer stong 'dud dang / rnam par grags pa'i yid dang / pad+ma'i phyag dang / yid kyi shing rta dang / tshig 'byin pa po dang / rab tu bzhad pa dang / sgra bzang dang / skra mtha' dang / rgyu skar dang / rgyu skar rgyal po dang / zla ba'i bu dang / skal bzang dang / 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dang / mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / lha las rnam rgyal dang / 'dod pa phun tshogs byed dang / legs par 'dul ba dang / 'dul ba po zhes pa 'di rnams dang / /

head: saṃsāra
target: 'khor ba'i rjes su 'khor bas rtag tu yid skyo la/ rgyud la snying rje chen po spangs shing sems la bag chags bsgos pa kho na sngon byang chub tu sems bskyed pa nyid yongs su bsgos par sems pa ste/ sa gcig dang / sa gnyis dang / sa gsum dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad kyi bar du 'jug pa'i sems dang 'khor bas skyo zhing 'jigs la 'jigs par byed pa de yongs su bsgos pa'i sems pas sa gcig dang / sa gnyis dang / sa gsum dang / ji srid byang chub sems dpa'i sa brgyad pa'i bar la yid mi 'jug pa/ 'khor bas yid skyo zhing /

head: mantra
target: dag pa'i sems dpa' sngags kyi spyod pa'i don rnam par gtan la dbab pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u rab 'byam byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod gang 'di bshad pa'i dus la bab par sems na shod cig / sems can dag gsang sngags kyi spyod pa'i don rnam par nges pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u rab 'byam byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod gang da lta de'i dus la bab par shes na shod cig /

src_sentence: yaḥ tasmin sthāne sucaukṣaṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ samantāccaturacaṃ poḍaśahastaṃ dvādaśahastaṃ vā apagatapāṣāṇakaṭhaṇṇabhasmāṅgāratuṣakapālāsthivarjitaṃ su- caukṣa supasuparikarmitaṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ nighrātmakenodakena pañcagavyasa- nmiśritena candanakarpūrakuṅkumodakena vā yamāntakena krodharājenāṣṭasa- hastrābhimantritena pañcaśikhamahāmudrāsaṃyuktena taṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ abhyukṣa- yencaturdikṣu ityūrdhvamadhāstiryag vidikṣu ca sarvataḥ kṣipet

target: dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang yan lag thams cad mdzes pa dang / bram ze dang rgyal rigs dang rje'u rigs dang dmangs rigs dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / theg pa chen por zhugs pa'i rang bzhin can dang theg pa dman pa mi 'dod pa'i ngang tshul can dang / sems dpa' chen po dang dad pa dang ldan pa dang / dge ba'i chos can dang rgyal po chen po mngon par 'dod pa dang longs spyod chung ba la smod pa dang / longs spyod chen po mngon par 'dod pa dang ldan pa dang / / 'dir ni mdor bsdus bstan pa yin/ / de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis dang po nyid du slob ma gzung bar bya bya ba la/ mdor bsdus 'dir ni bstan pa yin/ / de nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyis dang po nyid du slob ma gzung bar bya ste/ dbang po ma tshang ba med pa dang yan lag thams cad mdzes pa'i bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje rigs dang / dmangs rigs byang chub tu sems bskyed pa theg pa chen po'i theg pa pa/
src_sentence: tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pūrvamevānugṛhītavyāḥ avikale- ndriyāḥ sarvāṅgaśobhanāḥ brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśudrāḥ utpāditabodhicittāḥ mahāyānayāyinaḥ itarayānāspṛhaṇaśīlā mahāsattvāḥ śraddhā kalyāṇadha- rmiṇaḥ mahārājyābhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ alpabhogajugupsanāḥ mahābhogābhiruci- dvitīyaḥ parivartaḥ |

target: de nyid kyi sngags kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la yang bzla ste/ me tog nA ga ge sar dang pun nA ga dang ba ku la dang tsam pa ka dang dbyar gyi me tog dang d+hA nush+ka ri dang mA la ti'i me tog la sogs pas ras de gcal bkram pa byas la/ shar du mngon par phyogs pas ku sha'i khres la 'dug ste blo legs par gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la dmigs pa'i sems kyis pir phra mo lag par blangs nas/ / ras de la ni mngon par gtor/ / shar du mngon phyogs ku sha yi/ / khres la nyer 'dug dad pa'i blos/ /

head: samantāt
target: mdog dkar po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mi dang 'dra ba/ phyed sbrul gyi gzugs can dga' bo dang nye dga' bri bar bya'o/ / kun nas pad+ma'i mtsho pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang me tog cung zad kha bye ba dang / rnam par kha bye ba dang chu las skyes pa'i srog chags rnams dang / bya dang nya la sogs pas khyab pa yangs shing mdzes par skyes pa bri bar bya'o/ / pad+ma'i mtsho de'i khor yug tu pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang / me tog dang / cung zad kha bye ba dang rnam par kha bye ba dang / chu las skyes pa'i bya dang / nya la sogs pas mngon par khyab pa/ ma lus par bkod pa/ mdzes pa'i rnam par mngon par bri bar bya'o/ /
src_sentence: samantācca tat padmaśaraṃ padmapatrapuṣpakamala- vikasitajalajaprāṇibhiśca śakunamīnādibhirvyāptaṃ aśeṣavinyastasuci- rasuśobhanākāramabhilekhyam

head: tad
target: 'di lta ste rin chen gtsug tor can rin po che bai DUr+ya'i 'od rnam par 'phro ba/ pad+ma rA ga dang / in+d+ra nI la dang / ma ra ka ta la sogs pa dang / bai DUr+ya dang / rdo'i snying po la sogs pa nor bu rin po che chen po'i khyad par rnams kyis kun nas rab tu 'bar bzhin pa/ cung zad nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog 'dra ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chos gos ser po'i stod g.yogs mnabs pa/
src_sentence: tadyathā - ratnāśa- khivaidūryaprabhāratnavicchuritasamantavyāmaprabhaṃ padmarāgendranīlamarakatādi- bhiḥ vaidūryāśmagarbhādibhiḥ mahāmaṇiratnaviśeṣaiḥ samantato prajvālyamāṇaṃ, īṣadādityodayavarṇa tathāgatavigrahaṃ pītacīvarottarāsaṅginaṃ paryaṅkopaviṣṭaṃ dharma deśayamānaṃ pītanivāsitoparivastaṃ mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇakavacitadehaṃ, agnītyānuvyañjanopaśobhitamūrtti praśāntadarśanaṃ sarvākāravaropetaṃ ratna- śirkhi tathāgatamabhilikhet ||

target: steng du gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu gzhan gnyis nye bar kun nas gos kyi bla re chu zhing yangs pa shin tu mdzes pa 'dzin cing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos rnams kyi steng du lha'i gos dang phreng ba 'dzin pa bri bar bya'o/ / bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i steng dbu'i steng du mu tig gi phreng ba dang / thag gu dmar po pad+ma rA ga dang / in+d+ra nI la la sogs pa'i mdud pa byas pa rin po che'i thag gu'i tshogs bya'o/ / de la yang gos kyi bla re shin tu legs par kun nas bkod pa dang / mu tig gi phreng ba 'phyang bas mdzes pa bri bar bya'o/ / steng ngos su'ang gnas gtsang ma'i lha dang / nye bar gnas pa'i lha'i bu gzhan gnyis dar gyi bla re kun nas chur ring zhing shin tu mdzes pa bzung nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad kyi steng du 'dzin par byed bzhin pa lha'i phreng ba dang gos 'chang ba'i lha'i bu mngon par bri'o/ /

head: ādi
target: pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga dang mgo 'dud pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i g.yon logs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ snga ma ci lta ba de bzhin du bri bar bya ste/ dang po re zhig gnas gtsang ma'i gnas kun nas mdzes pa'i rnam pa rin po che shel gyi rang bzhin lta bu mu tig dkar po'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa 'drir gzhug par bya ste/ rin po che seng ge'i khri la nye bar bzhugs pa/
src_sentence: ādau tāvat śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ samantaśobhanākāraṃ sphuṭitaratna- mayākāraṃ sitamuktāhārabhūpitaṃ tasmi madhye bhagavāṃśchākyamuniḥ citrāpayitavyaḥ ratnasiṃhāsanopaniṣaṇṇaḥ dharma deśayamānaḥ sarvākāra- varopetaḥ, dakṣiṇapārśve āryamañjuśrīḥ padmakiñjalkābhaḥ kuṅkumāditya- varṇo vā vāmaskandhapradeśe nīlotpalāvasaktaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ bhagavantaṃ śākyamuniṃ nirīkṣamāṇaḥ īṣatprahasitavadanaḥ kumārarūpī pañcacīrakopa- śobhitaśiraskaḥ bāladārakālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ dakṣiṇajānumaṇḍalāvanata- śiraḥ bhagavataśca śākyamunervāmapārśve āryāvalokiteśvaraḥ śaratkā- ṇḍagauro yathaiva pūrva tathaivamabhilekhyam |

bo: kun nas mdzes pa'i rnam pa rin po che shel gyi rang bzhin lta bu mu tig dkar po'i do shal gyis brgyan pa
target: pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga dang mgo 'dud pa'o/ / bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i g.yon logs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ snga ma ci lta ba de bzhin du bri bar bya ste/ dang po re zhig gnas gtsang ma'i gnas kun nas mdzes pa'i rnam pa rin po che shel gyi rang bzhin lta bu mu tig dkar po'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa 'drir gzhug par bya ste/ rin po che seng ge'i khri la nye bar bzhugs pa/
src_sentence: ādau tāvat śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ samantaśobhanākāraṃ sphuṭitaratna- mayākāraṃ sitamuktāhārabhūpitaṃ tasmi madhye bhagavāṃśchākyamuniḥ citrāpayitavyaḥ ratnasiṃhāsanopaniṣaṇṇaḥ dharma deśayamānaḥ sarvākāra- varopetaḥ, dakṣiṇapārśve āryamañjuśrīḥ padmakiñjalkābhaḥ kuṅkumāditya- varṇo vā vāmaskandhapradeśe nīlotpalāvasaktaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ bhagavantaṃ śākyamuniṃ nirīkṣamāṇaḥ īṣatprahasitavadanaḥ kumārarūpī pañcacīrakopa- śobhitaśiraskaḥ bāladārakālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ dakṣiṇajānumaṇḍalāvanata- śiraḥ bhagavataśca śākyamunervāmapārśve āryāvalokiteśvaraḥ śaratkā- ṇḍagauro yathaiva pūrva tathaivamabhilekhyam |

head: śakra
target: lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang 'thab bral dang dga' ldan dang 'phrul dga' dang dag pa dang / dri ma med pa dang 'jam pa dang mi gdung ba dang 'od gsal dang / tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po dang 'og min dang de la sogs pa'i lha'i bu gzugs na spyod pa dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu dag mthar gyis bri bar bya'o/ / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang nye bar 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor legs par dgod par bya ste/ rang rang gi gzugs dang cha byad du bri bar bya'o/ / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang / rab 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / / 'phrul dga' dang / dag pa dang / dri ma med pa dang / shin tu mthong dang / 'od gsal dang / tshangs pa mi mjed kyi bdag po dang / 'og min te de lta bu la sogs pa'i lha'i bu gzugs na spyod pa dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams rim gyis mngon par bri bar bya'o/ / / /
src_sentence: śakraśca devānāmindraḥ sa- yāmaśca santuṣitaśca sunirmitaśca śuddhaśca vimalaśca sudṛśaśca atapaśca ābhāsvaraśca brahmā ca sahāmpatiḥ akaniṣṭhaśca evamādayo devaputrā rūpāvacarāḥ kāmāvacarāścānupūrvato'bhilekhyāḥ āryamañjuśriyasamī- pasthāḥ parṣanmaṇḍaloparicitavinyastāḥ svarūpaveṣadhāriṇo citrāpayi- tavyāḥ |

head: bhagavant
target: bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa ni legs so legs so/ / rig pa thams cad kyi brtul zhugs spyad pa'i don dang / phan pa dang bde ba dang 'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i phyir dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rig pa dang / sngags kyi spyod pa thams cad kyi don sgrub par byed pa bdag gi rig pa gsang chen 'di nyid skye bo thams cad rgyas par byed par 'gyur ba ma 'ongs pa'i dus 'jig rten gyi bla mar mya ngan las 'das pa na de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i rigs nub pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad kyis spangs shing thams cad bor te mun par gyur pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten rnam par zhig ste 'phags pa'i lam dang / rig pa dang / sngags dang / sman dang / nor bu rin po che thams cad dang bral ba/ skye bo legs pas yongs su bzung ba'i snang ba med pa'i sems can gyi khams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ / le lo can dang / dran pa nyams pa dang / ma dad pa dang / mi srun pa dang / mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa sgyu dang g.yo dang / brdzun dang g.yo ba'i spyod pa dang ldan pa de rnams/

src_sentence: śobhanaṃ ca tat padmadaṇḍe marakatapadmākāraṃ anekapadmapuṣpamukulitaṃ patropetaṃ vikasitārdhavikasita- puṣpamahāsarānavataptotthitaṃ dvau nāgarājāvaṣṭabdhanābhaṃ nandopanandasa- ndhāritaṃ tat padmadaṇḍaṃ sitavarṇā ca tau nāgarājānau saptasphaṭāvaṃbhū- ṣitau sarvālaṅkāraśobhitaśarīrau manuṣyārthakāyau ahibhogāṅkitamūrtaya āryamañjuśriyaṃ nirīkṣamāṇau jalāntārthanilīnau maṇiratnopaśobhita- cchadau likhāpayitavyau ||

head: upariṣṭāt
target: cha byad dang kha dog snga ma ci lta ba bzhin bri bar bya'o/ / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi steng ras kyi zur gnyis su lha'i bu me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nam mkha' la lding ba/ cha byad dang kha dog ji lta ba bzhin du mngon par bri'o/ / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi steng du/ ras kyi mtha' gnyis su lha'i bu phreng ba 'dzin pa gnyis me tog gi phreng ba bzung nas nam mkha' la lding ba/
src_sentence: upariṣṭādāryamañjuśriyasya ubhau paṭāntakoṇābhyāṃ dvau devaputrau mālādhāriṇau puṣpamālāggṛhītau utpatamānau meghāntārnalīnau mahāpu- ṣpaughamutsṛjamānau suśobhanau abhilekhyau ||

head: yatheṣṭa
target: ci ltar 'dod par 'gro zhing lha'i gzugs dang ldan pa dang / nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang 'od kyi phreng ba chen po dang ldan pa dang / lus shin tu gsal bar 'gyur ba dang rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu 'gyur ro/ / ring du 'tsho zhing bskal pa chen por gnas pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khri phrag brgya stong gi 'khor du ma dang ldan pa dang / lha'i nor bu rin po che'i gzhal med khang la spyod pa dang bzhon pa gang sngar yongs su brtags pa sa'i rang bzhin grub na/ rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag / ring du 'tsho zhing bskal pa chen por gnas pa rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor lha'i nor bu rin po che'i gzhal yas khang na spyod pa/ / sngar yongs su brtags pa'i sa'i rang bzhin gyi bzhon pa gang gis grub pa de nyid mthu chen por 'gyur te/
src_sentence: yatheṣṭaṃ gacchati divyarūpī uditādityasaṅkāśaḥ mahāprabhāmālī vidyudyotitamūrttiḥ sarvavidyādharaprabhuḥ dīrghajīvī mahākalpasthaḥ aneka- vidyādharakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraparivāraḥ divyamahāmaṇiratnacārī yena vā vāhanena pūrvaparikalpitena dṛṣṭa yena siddho sa evāsya mahāprabhāvo bhava- ti

target: ci ltar 'dod par 'gro zhing lha'i gzugs dang ldan pa dang / nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang 'od kyi phreng ba chen po dang ldan pa dang / lus shin tu gsal bar 'gyur ba dang rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu 'gyur ro/ / ring du 'tsho zhing bskal pa chen por gnas pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khri phrag brgya stong gi 'khor du ma dang ldan pa dang / lha'i nor bu rin po che'i gzhal med khang la spyod pa dang bzhon pa gang sngar yongs su brtags pa sa'i rang bzhin grub na/ rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag / ring du 'tsho zhing bskal pa chen por gnas pa rig pa 'dzin pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor lha'i nor bu rin po che'i gzhal yas khang na spyod pa/ / sngar yongs su brtags pa'i sa'i rang bzhin gyi bzhon pa gang gis grub pa de nyid mthu chen por 'gyur te/
src_sentence: yatheṣṭaṃ gacchati divyarūpī uditādityasaṅkāśaḥ mahāprabhāmālī vidyudyotitamūrttiḥ sarvavidyādharaprabhuḥ dīrghajīvī mahākalpasthaḥ aneka- vidyādharakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraparivāraḥ divyamahāmaṇiratnacārī yena vā vāhanena pūrvaparikalpitena dṛṣṭa yena siddho sa evāsya mahāprabhāvo bhava- ti

target: de bzhin du sems can sgrub pa dang bral ba/ sngags rig pas 'di lta bur 'jig pa dang rnam par g.yeng ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshogs kyis nye bar khyab pa/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho thibs po gnas pa'i bdag nyid du mthong zhing gnas med pa dang skyob pa med pa dang / skyabs med pa dang / shin tu dman pa'i yid can gyi bdag nyid du brtags nas sgom pa po mgrin pa nub tsam gyi chu na gnas pa'am/ lte ba tsam du gnas pa'i chu de nyid kyi nang du sems rtse gcig tu nye bar gzung bar bya'o/ / bdag med pa dang / stong pa dang / sdug bsngal dang ldan pa dang / sdug bsngal nye bar 'gags pa dang / tshor bas mngon par non pa dang / chu rlabs bzhin du mngon par 'byung ba'i rab tu sbyor ba'i sdug bsngal dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams 'di ltar sgrub pa dang bral ba sngags shes pas gang de bzhin du dug dang / gcod pa dang / ltung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jigs pa la sogs pa rnams kyis sdug bsngal gyi phung po nye bar 'gog par bya bzhin pa/

head: mahāsattva
target: chen po'i rin po che'i le'u rab 'byam 'di ngas kyang rjes su gnang zhing sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang gsungs te/ sems can dag pa'i rang gi sngags spyod pa'i don gyi chos kyi mdzod/ skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / lha dang mi rnams dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du bstan pa'i phyir ro/ / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rang gi yon tan 'byung ba/ sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad don yang dag par thob par byed pa dang / rig sngags dang / / gsang sngags kyi tshig thams cad dang / gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba dang bcas pa dang / phyag rgya dang / dkyil 'khor dang / rtog pa'i dbang bskur ba dang / tshe dang / nad med pa dang / dbang phyug dang / bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / sgrub thabs thams cad kyi cho ga'i rgyud dang / shes pa dang shes bya dus kyi mthar nub pa dang / rgyal srid dang / zhing 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba mdor bsdus pa las/

head: caryā
target: sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i lam la dgod pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rig pa'i tshig dang / sngags kyi tshig dang / gzungs dang / sman gyi cha byad 'dzin pa dang / 'dab chags kyi tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / nor bu dang / sngags dang / rin po che'i rgyal po dang / sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi grangs su rjes su yang dag par 'jug pa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi bsam pa ci ltar 'dul bar byed pa de bzhin du byed pa rnams dang / de dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming dang 'brel ba rnams dang / rig pa'i rgyal po'i nye bar bstan pa dang / chos ci lta ba bzhin du rtog pa las nges par 'byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs kyi rjes su zhugs pa/ dam tshig las mi 'da' zhing tshig gis lam la 'jog par byed pa/ gtsug tor mngon par 'phags pa dang / gdugs dkar mngon par 'phags pa dang / lo ma mtha' yas dang / lo ma brgya pa dang / gtsug tor rgyal ba dang / mngon par 'phags pa'i gtsug tor dang / pad+ma'i 'od zer dang / gser gyi 'od zer dang / 'od zer dkar po dang / gtsug tor bkod pa dang / gser gyi phung po dang / dkar po'i phung po dang / gzi brjid phung po dang / nor bu'i phung po dang / kun nas phung po dang / rnam par grags pa'i phung po dang / 'byung ba'i phung po dang / bden pa'i phung po dang / dngos po med pa'i phung po dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi phung po ste/ 'di rnams dang / / gzhan yang gtsug tor gyi rgyal po chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa la rab tu zhugs pa sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du mngon par 'dod pa yongs su skong bar byed pa/

target: sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i lam la dgod pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rig pa'i tshig dang / sngags kyi tshig dang / gzungs dang / sman gyi cha byad 'dzin pa dang / 'dab chags kyi tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / nor bu dang / sngags dang / rin po che'i rgyal po dang / sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi grangs su rjes su yang dag par 'jug pa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi bsam pa ci ltar 'dul bar byed pa de bzhin du byed pa rnams dang / de dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming dang 'brel ba rnams dang / rig pa'i rgyal po'i nye bar bstan pa dang / chos ci lta ba bzhin du rtog pa las nges par 'byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje'i rigs dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs kyi rjes su zhugs pa/ dam tshig las mi 'da' zhing tshig gis lam la 'jog par byed pa/ gtsug tor mngon par 'phags pa dang / gdugs dkar mngon par 'phags pa dang / lo ma mtha' yas dang / lo ma brgya pa dang / gtsug tor rgyal ba dang / mngon par 'phags pa'i gtsug tor dang / pad+ma'i 'od zer dang / gser gyi 'od zer dang / 'od zer dkar po dang / gtsug tor bkod pa dang / gser gyi phung po dang / dkar po'i phung po dang / gzi brjid phung po dang / nor bu'i phung po dang / kun nas phung po dang / rnam par grags pa'i phung po dang / 'byung ba'i phung po dang / bden pa'i phung po dang / dngos po med pa'i phung po dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi phung po ste/ 'di rnams dang / / gzhan yang gtsug tor gyi rgyal po chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa la rab tu zhugs pa sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du mngon par 'dod pa yongs su skong bar byed pa/

target: 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i gzhal med khang nor bu rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing rmad du byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa la zhugs pa dang / sa bcu'i dbang phyug la gnas pa dag gis kyang dkyil 'khor de bri ba'am 'drir gzhug par mi nus na so so'i skye bor gyur pa'i sems can gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ dkyil 'khor de bri ba'am 'drir 'jug par mi nus na/ so so'i skye bor gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor chen po gnas rnam par bkra ba'i phyag na rin po che'i snying po rgyan bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab cing rmad du byung ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sa bcu dang ldan pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug la gnas pa rnams kyis kyang /
src_sentence: yatra samādheḥ pratiṣṭhitasya aśeṣasattvanirhāracaryāmanasaḥ sarvasattvā prati- ṣṭhitāḥ bhaveyuḥ, samanantarasamāpannasya mañjuśriyaḥ kumārabhūtasya sarvā- vantaṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ vicitramaṇiranavyūhālaṅkāramaṇḍalaṃ acintyā- dyutabodhisattvavikurvaṇaṃ sarvapratyekabuddhāryaśrāvakacaryāpraviṣṭairapi bodhi- sattvaiḥ daśabhūmipratiṣṭhiteśvarairapi na śakyate maṇḍalaṃ likhituṃ vā, kaḥ punarvādo pṛthagjanabhūtaiḥ sattvaiḥ ta divyamāryamaṇḍalasamayanirdhāra- vasthānāvasthitaṃ mañjuśriyaṃ kumārabhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve buddhā bhagavantaḥ sarva- pratyekabuddhāḥ, sarve āryaśrāvakāḥ, sarve bodhisattvāḥ, daśabhūāmaprati- ṣṭhitāḥ, yauvarājyābhiṣekasamanuprāptā āryāḥ pratipannāśca sarve sattvā sāśravā anāśravāśca mañjuśriyaḥ kumārabhūtasyādhiṣṭhānenācintyaṃ buddha- bodhisatvācāryāniṣyanditaṃ samādhiviśeṣamānasodbhavaṃ maṇḍalaṃ praviṣṭamā- tmānaṃ sañjānante sma |

head: pūrva
target: shar gyi bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i steng du ri mo'i dbus su me tog kun nas skyes pa'i rgyal po'i dbang po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs cung zad chung bar bya'o/ / shar gyi phyogs su bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i steng du ri mo'i dbus su me tog gi rgyal po'i dbang po pad+ma'i gdan la nye bar bzhugs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs shin tu chung tsam du bya ste/ kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ phyag mchog sbyin pas rab tu sbyin pa/

bo: kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa

target: de bzhin du rgyan dang mtshon cha dang cha byad dang dbyibs dang kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs pa rim pa gnyis pa la brten te bri bar bya'o/ / thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sgo'i phyi rol du dka' zlog gi bdag po khyu mchog la zhon pa/ gser gyi mdog thal ba'i thig le gsum byas pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang / / mtshon cha dang / cha byad dang / dbyibs dang / kha dog de yang phreng gnyis pa la brten nas bri bar bya'o/ /
src_sentence: evaṃ nānākaraṇapraharaṇaveṣasaṃsthānavarṇatattvadvipaṅgī āśritā ā- lekhyāḥ |

head: aṣṭan
target: gza' brgyad dang rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / gang yang nye ba'i gza' brgyad sa steng gi dkyil 'khor na rab tu rgyu ba yang bri bar bya'o/ / mthar gyis tshes grangs bcwa lnga dang yar ngo dang mar ngo'i phyogs dang / khyim bcu gnyis dang dus drug dang zla ba bcu gnyis dang lo tshigs dang / sring mo bzhi gru la zhon pa dang ming po lnga gru la zhon zhing chu la gnas pa ste/ gza' brgyad dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun dang / gang sa stengs kyi dkyil 'khor la rab tu rgyu ba'i nye ba'i gza' brgyad kyang bri'o/ / go rims bzhin du/ dkar po dang / nag po'i tshes bco lnga dang / khyim bcu gnyis dang / dus drug dang / zla ba bcu gnyis dang / lo tshigs dang / sring mo bzhi gru la zhon pa dang / lnga pa ming po chu la gnas pa rnams te/
src_sentence: aṣṭau grahāḥ, saptaviṃśatinakṣatrāḥ, yeṣu caranti bhuvi maṇḍale upagrahācāṣṭā devā lekhyāḥ anupūrvaśaḥ pañcadaśa tithayaḥ sitakṛṣṇā, dvādaśa rāśayo ṣad ṛtavo, dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraśca |

head: upaspṛś
target: gos gtsang ma bgos pa'i gtsang bas me thab kyi drung du song ste/ ku sha'i khres la 'dug nas byang shar gyi phyogs su mngon par bltas te/ mar gyi sbyin sreg ga pur dang gur gum dang / tsan+dan dang bsres pas stong rtsa brgyad bya'o/ / nye reg byas te gos gtsang ma bgos pa'i gtsang mas/ me thab tu song nas/ ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste byang shar du mngon par phyogs pas ga bur dang gur gum tsan+dan dang bsres pa'i mar gyi sreg blugs stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg bya'o/ /
src_sentence: nirgatya ca ya- thāmmukhartukodakenāṣṭaśatābhimantritena mūlamantreṇa mahāmudrā pañcaśikha- sudritenodakena snātvā upaspṛśya ca śucirvastraprāvṛtena śucinā agni- kuṇḍaṃ gatvā kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭaḥ uttarapūrvābhimukhaḥ āhutīnāṃ karpūraku- kumacandanamiśrāṇāmaṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt ||

target: nges par yang bum pa gang ba brgyad ras gtsang ma'i gos dang ldan pa/ shing a mra'i lo ma dang 'bras bu dang ldan pa gser dang / / dngul dang rin po che dang / 'bras dang 'bru nang du bcug pa gcig bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa la dbul lo/ / zhugs nas bum pa gang ba brgyad gtsang ma'i gos dang ldan pa shing sa ha ka ra'i yal 'dab dang 'bras bus rnam par brgyan pa gser dang dngul dang rin po che dang / 'bru nang du bcug pa/ de lta bu bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa la so sor dbul bar bya'o/ /

head: dhūpa
target: bdug pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / srin po dang / sha za dang / 'byung po dang / rnal 'byor pa dang grub pa dang / drang srong rnams dang sems can thams cad yang dag par bdug nas me tog gtor te/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du rab tu zhugs pa rnams la/ de nas rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas pas mchod yon no/ / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / gzhan yang rdzu 'phrul chen po'i lha'i khyad par rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos rnams kyang gsan du gsol/
src_sentence: pūrvoktenaiva dhūpena sarvabuddhabodhisattvāṃ pratyekabuddhāryaśrāva- kāṃ sarvadevanāgayakṣagaruḍagandharvakinnaramahoragayakṣarākṣasapiśāca ginasiddhaṛṣayaḥ sarvasattvāṃ sandhūpya puṣpairavakīrya candanakuṅkumo- dakenābhyaṣiścet

head: bhagavant

target: me tog dri zhim pos gcal bkram pa la 'di lta ste/ me tog mA li ta dang dbyar gyi me tog dang / d+hA nuSh+ka ri ka dang pun nA ga dang nA ga ge sar la sogs pa'i me tog gis ras ris kun nas gcal bkram par bri bar bya'o/ / bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i g.yon phyogs su 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi steng du rin po che du mas nye bar spras pa/ bcom ldan 'das shAkya thub pa'i g.yon gyi gzhogs su 'phags pa 'jam dpal gang yin pa'i steng du rin po che du mas spras pa'i shin tu ring po'i rnam pa'i gzhal med kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ / brag ri'i rgyal po nye bar mdzes pa rin po che'i rdo leb kyis bkab pa ri bo'i rnam pa lta bur mngon par bri bar bya'o/ / mA la tI dang / bAr+Shi kA dang / d+ha nu ska ri kA dang / pun+nAg dang / nA ga ge sar la sogs pa'i me tog rnams kyis ras la kun nas gcal du bkram bzhin pas mngon par bri'o/ /
src_sentence: tadyathā - mālatīvārṣikādhānuṣkārikāpunnāganā- gakesarādibhiḥ puṣpaiḥ samantāt paṭamabhyavakīryamāṇaṃ likhitaṃ bhagavataḥ śākyamuneḥ vāmapārśve āryamañjuśriyasyopariṣṭāḥ anekaratnoparacitaṃ sudīrghākāraṃ vimānamaṇḍalaṃ śailarājopaśobhitaṃ ratnopalasañchannaparvatā- kāramabhilikhet ||

head: dvitīya
target: kun nas 'od 'dom gang ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor can mngon par bri'o/ / gnyis pa la de bzhin gshegs pa me tog yang dag par skyes pa'i rgyal po'i dbang po gser gyi mdog tu mngon par bri bar bya'o/ / nA ga ge sar ches bzang ba dang / ba ku la la sogs pa'i me tog rnams kyis mngon par gtor ba mngon par

src_sentence: ādau tāvat taṃ paṭaṃ gṛhya prātihārakaple anye vā śukle'hani śu- bhanakṣatrasaṃyukte śubhāyāṃ tithau śuklapakṣadivase vā suśobhanaiḥ śakunaiḥ maṅgalasammatāyāṃ rātrau ardharātrakālasamaye upoṣadhikena citrakareṇa taṃ paṭaṃ citrāpayet śucau pradeśe karpūradhūpaṃ dahatā

head: sakṛt
target: bud med mo sham bu mi skye ba skye bar 'dod na/ a shwa gan d+ha'i rtsa ba mar bzang po dang lhan cig bskol la/ ba'i 'o ma dang lhan cig bskol te ba'i 'o ma dang bsres la lan nyi shu rtsa lngar bzlas la zla mtshan gyi dus su blud la khrus byas pa'i 'og tu khyim bdag gzhan gyi chung ma spangs shing 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spangs pas/ gnyis bzlas pas so/ / bud med mo gsham mi skye ba'i chos rnams skye bar 'dod na a shwagan+d+ha'i rtsa ba'i mar dang lhan cig bskol te ba'i 'o mas bsres te lan nyi shu rtsa lnga yongs su bzlas te/ zla mtshan gyi dus su 'thung du bcug nas khrus byas pa'i mthar skyes pa gzhan spang zhing khyim pa yang 'dod pas log par g.yem pa yongs su spangs na/
src_sentence: sakṛjjaptena tu japtena vā vandhyāyāḥ striyā vā aprasavadharmiṇyāḥ prasa- vamākāṃkṣatā aśvagandhamūlaṃ gavyaghṛtena saha pācayitvā gavyakṣīreṇa saha pīṣayitvā gavyakṣīreṇaivādvālya paścaviṃśatparijapta ṛtukāle pāya- ye snānānte ca paradāravarjī gṛhī kamamithyācāravarjitaḥ svadārama- bhigacche

target: de bzhin du ma mo dang byis pa dang lus srul po dang ro langs dang gzhon nu'i gdon la sogs pa mi ma yin pa'i mi bzad pa'i gdon thams cad kyis zin pa la ni/ bdag nyid kyi lag pa la lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa byas nas gdon gyis zin pa'i mgo la reg par byas na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ / de bzhin du ma mo dang / byis pa dang / srul po dang / ro langs dang / grul bum gyi gdon la sogs pa rnams dang / mi thams cad gdug pa can drag pos mngon par zin pa la bdag nyid kyi lag pa la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags te/ zin pa de'i mgo bo la reg na bde bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /
src_sentence: evaṃ mātarabālapūtanavetālakumāragrahādiṣu sarvāmānuṣaduṣṭadāruṇagṛhīteṣu ātmano hastamaṣṭacatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītakaṃ mastake spṛśet

src_sentence: taṃ paṭasyāgrataḥ sthāpayitvā acchinnāgraiḥ kuśaiḥ śucideśasa- mudbhavaiḥ cakrākāraṃ kṛtvā paṭasyāgrataḥ dakṣiṇahastena gṛhītvā vāmahastena mayūraṃ śuklapūrṇamāsyāṃ rātrau paṭasya mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā karpūradhūpaṃ dahatā tāvajjaped yāvatprabhāta iti ||

head: cakra
target: de nas lha'i phreng ba dang gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan par 'gyur ro/ / nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba'i 'dod pa'i gzugs mdzes par 'gyur ro/ / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la phyag byas nas/ 'khor lo yang 'bar ro/ / bdag nyid lha'i phreng ba dang gos 'chang zhing rnam par brgyan pa dang / nyi ma 'char ka 'dra bar 'dod pa'i gzugs can du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas te ras ris la bskor ba byas la ras ris blangs nas rma bya'i gdan de la 'dug na yud tsam gyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las 'da' bar byed do/ /
src_sentence: cakraścādīptaḥ | ātmanaśca divyadehī divyamālyāmbarābharaṇavibhū- ṣitaḥ uditādityasaṅkāśaḥ kāmarūpī | sarvabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ praṇamya paṭaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya paṭaṃ gṛhītvā tasmi mayūrāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ muhū- rtena brahmalokamatikrāmati |
